title: Skill types are shared by all departments; in Zoho each department has its own skill types
label: BUG vs ZOHO
env: TAVI staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging, owner) · Setup → Skills · Zoho Desk org techsolutionsegypt (admin), dept Haytham Mohamed, Setup → Skills

panels.caption: TAVI: Setup → Skills → Skills tab has a Department picker (skills are per department)
TAVI: Skill Types tab has no Department picker and says "Every department uses the same types"; one list for all departments
Zoho: Setup → Skills → SKILLS tab, department picker (Haytham Mohamed)
Zoho: SKILL TYPES tab keeps the same department picker; the list sits under that department ("test" with skill 1)

rows: Skills tab has a department picker; skills belong to one department (seen).
Same: Skills tab has a Department picker and skills are per department.
SKILL TYPES tab has the same department picker as the SKILLS tab (seen), so skill types are managed per department.
Skill Types tab has no department picker; help text says "Every department uses the same types." The API (GET /desk/skill-types) returns one list with no department.
The list sits under the selected department (Haytham Mohamed): type "test" with its associated skill "skill 1" (seen; other departments not opened).
One list for all departments (General, Tech, QA AS6 Type, QA AS6 Type3); a type cannot belong to a single department.
